name: Soni (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Soni village emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring with pointed ears and a winged stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Soni, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Soni village emblem — a stylised device of a ring with pointed ears and a winged stroke
